measurement_device.guidance: Use weight as a primary measurement. Store bioimpedance body-composition values as trend indicators; compare under similar conditions.

notes: Initial nutrition targets established for the pre-December 2026 fat-loss phase. Targets are starting estimates and should be calibrated against real-world trends.

target_strategy.exercise_calories: Do not automatically eat back exercise calories; consider additional intake for unusually high activity.
target_strategy.calibration: Review actual weight, waist, hunger, energy and training trends over 2–4 weeks and adjust if required.
